entities.summary: Avraham "Avi" Primor is an Israeli publicist and former diplomat. From 1987 to 1993, he served as Ambassador to the European Union, and from 1993 to 1999 as Ambassador to Germany. After leaving the diplomatic service, he was vice-president of the University of Tel Aviv until 2004. While Ambassador to Germany, Primor rose to national prominence as one of the most important promoters of the German-Israeli dialogue. He has been awarded the Mérite européen award for his contribution to European unification, as well as the Grand Cross with Star and Sash of the Order of Merit of the Federal Republic of Germany.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: As Ambassador to Germany from 1993 to 1999, Avi Primor played a crucial role in promoting the German-Israeli dialogue, fostering increased economic and cultural cooperation between the two nations. His efforts contributed significantly to strengthening bilateral relations.
